# EM 385-1-1 16-Hour Training for Workers

> 16-hour online introductory safety training for non-supervisory workers on U.S. Department of Defense construction and environmental projects administered by USACE, developed in line with the 2024 EM 385-1-1 Safety and Health Requirements Manual. Available in English and Spanish. Offered by HAZWOPER OSHA Training (https://hazwoper-osha.com).

## Key facts
- Duration: 16 hours; 14 modules, 45 lessons, final exam
- Credits: 1.6 CEU
- Price: $114.99 per person; bulk pricing available
- Delivery: 100% online, 24/7; SCORM, virtual instructor-led and in-person formats also available
- Languages: English, Spanish
- Prerequisites: none
- Certificate: certificate of completion from HAZWOPER OSHA Training; valid 12 months; 8-hour refresher annually
- Not government-approved: federal agencies do not approve or endorse any EM 385-1-1 training course
- EM 385-1-1 includes OSHA standards plus NFPA, EPA, DOT, ANSI and UFGS requirements

## Modules (with EM 385-1-1 chapters)
1. Introduction to EM 385-1-1 and Safety Culture
2. Safety and Health Program Management (Ch. 1-2)
3. Sanitation, Medical and First Aid (Ch. 3)
4. Temporary Facilities and Site Conditions (Ch. 4)
5. Personal Protective and Lifesaving Equipment (Ch. 5)
6. Welding, Cutting and Brazing (Ch. 10)
7. Electrical Safety and Hazardous Energy Control (Ch. 11-12)
8. Tools and Equipment (Ch. 13)
9. Material Handling, Storage and Disposal (Ch. 14)
10. Demolition, Renovation and Specialized Construction (Ch. 17, 27, 28)
11. Vehicles, Machinery and Mechanized Equipment (Ch. 18)
12. Fall Protection (Ch. 21-24)
13. Confined Spaces (Ch. 34)
14. Excavation, Trenching and Underground Construction (Ch. 25-26)
